base_value_note: base_value (Adjusted EBITDA) and revenue_base are FY2025 [01_historical-financials.md §4; Integrated Annual Report 2025, p.37] — the period the coefficients' deltas apply to. Each sensitivities[].base_value below is that variable's own CURRENT level (Q1 2026 — see base_value_period), carried for context only; it is not used by the linear scale (delta × coefficient applies directly to the FY2025 base above). This mixes two periods by design, per CLAUDE.md §15, so both periods are labelled explicitly rather than left implicit.

sensitivities.label: LME aluminium price
sensitivities.non_linearity: 1.5-2mo pricing realization lag; disclosed per-unit rate anchored near base, may not hold far from it
sensitivities.source: FY2025 Annual Report, p.38 (per-unit coefficient); Q1 FY2026 results (First Quarter Report 2026), p.12, p.19 (Q1 2026 base value of USD 3,192/mt)

sensitivities.label: USD/NOK exchange rate
sensitivities.non_linearity: sustainable operating effect only; a same-size move also carries a separate disclosed one-off revaluation of -NOK 680m on financial items, NOT included here
sensitivities.source: FY2025 Annual Report, p.38 (per-unit coefficient); Q1 FY2026 results (First Quarter Report 2026), p.19 (Q1 2026 base value of 9.73)

sensitivities.label: Alumina price (realized, Bauxite & Alumina segment)
sensitivities.non_linearity: inferred per-unit (no disclosed alumina EBITDA-per-USD/mt); blends the period cost cushion and may not hold at other price levels. base_value and coefficient are calibrated to the REALIZED alumina price (Q1'26: USD 345/mt), not the Platts PAX index (Q1'26: USD 307/mt per 02_revenue-drivers.md §4) — do not apply this coefficient to a PAX-quoted move.
sensitivities.source: nhy-presentation-q1-2026.pdf, p.15; Integrated Annual Report 2025, p.37

sensitivities.label: Extrusions external sales volume
sensitivities.non_linearity: per-kmt rate is company-disclosed for one quarter, extrapolated to a full-year swing; operating deleverage means a small volume decline can produce an outsized margin move
